name: Trimethylindium
state_and_key_properties: White solid; mp 88 C; decomposes above 101 C; pyrophoric; log P(Torr)=10.98-3204/T; evaporation rate fluctuates (solid)
growth_temp_basis: In2O3 ALD: O3 100-200 C, H2O 200-250 C; InAs MOVPE with TBAs specular 480-540 C; with AsH3 600 down to 275 C but incomplete pyrolysis below ~400 C; decomposes even at 160 C in MOVPE

name: Triethylindium
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; mp -32 C; bp 92 C at 10 mmHg; pyrophoric (H250)
growth_temp_basis: Listed as an In2O3 ALD precursor (window not extracted)

name: Cyclopentadienylindium(I)
state_and_key_properties: Sublimes ~50 C at 0.01 mmHg; Cp byproducts raise carbon impurity

name: Indium trichloride
state_and_key_properties: HCl byproduct corrosive; window 300-500 C with H2O/H2O2

name: Indium acetylacetonate
state_and_key_properties: Window 165-220 C with H2O; thermal decomposition tendency

name: Indium tris(tetramethylheptanedionate)
state_and_key_properties: mp 175 C; less volatile than In(acac)3
growth_temp_basis: O2 plasma; bubbler ~200 C in MOCVD

name: Tris(N,N'-diisopropylformamidinato)indium
state_and_key_properties: ALD window 150-275 C with H2O; carbon-free films
growth_temp_basis: H2O co-reactant; evaporation needs ~127 C heating

name: Tris(N,N'-diisopropylacetamidinato)indium
state_and_key_properties: Sublimes at 150 C; no melting up to 320 C (decomposes)
growth_temp_basis: In2S3 ALD with H2S; sublimation 150 C, delivery at 190 C without N2 assist

name: Indium tris(guanidinate)
state_and_key_properties: Window 230-300 C with H2O; significant decomposition above 110 C

name: Diethyl[bis(trimethylsilyl)amido]indium
state_and_key_properties: Liquid In precursor; H2O process 175-250 C

name: [3-(Dimethylamino)propyl]dimethylindium
growth_temp_basis: In2O3 ALD with H2O (window not extracted)

name: Tris(1,3-diisopropyltriazenide)indium
state_and_key_properties: Hexacoordinated In-N precursor; H2O thermal ALD
growth_temp_basis: Thermal ALD In2O3 with H2O (window not extracted)

name: Trimethylindium-dimethylethylamine adduct
state_and_key_properties: High thermal stability; self-limiting InAs ALE 350-500 C
growth_temp_basis: Self-limiting InAs ALE 350-500 C; InAs/GaAs superlattice at 460 C
